pages.text: An insulated box. Food inside stops spoiling for as long as the container stays intact.$(br2)It also stops $(l:advanced/frozen_atmosphere_shard)Atmosphere Shards$(/l) from sublimating.$(br2)Craft one early and stock it before farming fails.
$(italic)The most important lunchbox in history. Every other lunchbox is frozen solid.$()
Iron corners, leather sides, a glass bottle center for the vacuum seal. The locking mechanism budget went to Kevin's search-and-rescue fund.
